title: Quantum computers
summary: Build two-qubit circuits: superposition, interference and entanglement, and where qubits could help.

ideas.how: error correction spreads one reliable qubit over many noisy ones
qubits compute with superposition and interference

then: Quantum computing is an idea (Feynman, 1982); Shor's factoring algorithm arrives in 1994.
Labs build machines with a handful to dozens of qubits.
Google claims quantum supremacy (2019) on a 53-qubit chip; error rates are still too high for useful work.
Error correction starts to work: logical qubits beat physical ones.
Plans: error-corrected machines are scaled up for the first useful applications.
Plans: fault-tolerant quantum computers from IBM and Quantinuum, targeted for 2029.

challenges.title: Entangle two qubits
challenges.task: Build circuits for certainty, interference and entanglement.

ask: What problems will quantum computers solve first?
Why do qubits need error correction?
